project.title: BAKEBOX-AI: AUTONOMOUS AI Bakery Management AND CUSTOMER SUPPORT
project.short_description: Enterprise autonomous AI bakery management and customer engagement platform powered by CHOCO AI — leveraging IBM Db2 hybrid storage (relational ACID tables + native vector search via DB2LlamaVS), LlamaIndex Advanced Hybrid RAG fusing IBM Db2 native dense vectors with BM25 and TF-IDF lexical search via 3-way Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF: k=60), session isolation with conversation buffer memory, and real-time agentic tools for up-to-3 cake precision recommendations and live order tracking.

members.name: Ayush Dhangar
members.role: BTech CSE-AIML, 4th Year | AI Systems & Db2 Solutions Architect

ibm_db2.edition: Db2 Community Edition (Docker / VS Code Extension - IBMDB201)
features_used: Native VECTOR(384, FLOAT32) Column via DB2LlamaVS
In-engine Cosine Vector Search via DB2LlamaVS
Advanced Hybrid RRF (k=60) Multi-Channel Fused Retrieval (Db2 Dense + BM25 + TF-IDF)
Direct DB-API 2.0 Connection Management with Automatic Commit/Rollback
